value.name: A vegetable category (veg_cat.category_name) within a calendar year; statistics aggregate item_code-level wholesale-price records (veg_whsle_df), transactions (veg_txn_df) and loss rates (veg_loss_rate_df).

fields.value: All records are included: no entity is dropped for zero activity, zero-valued loss rates are retained, and return transactions are handled by their stored quantity sign.
fields.rationale: The request gives no zero/empty policy; keeping all records is the most literal reading and avoids silently changing the population.

value: No filter other than restricting to calendar years 2020–2023 (the only years present).

value.note: wholesale price per item-day; transaction qty_sold and unit_selling_px per transaction; loss_rate per item; category per item

value.expression: Calendar years 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023 (Jan 1–Dec 31 each); data actually spans 2020-07-01 to 2023-06-30.

fields.value: whsle_date for wholesale prices; txn_date for transactions.
fields.rationale: Each fact table carries its own event date column; no shared calendar table exists.

fields.value: Transaction rows are many per item-day, while wholesale price and loss rate are one row per item-day / per item. Sources must be pre-aggregated to the category×year grain before combining; do not join raw transaction rows to the daily price table (fan-out).
fields.rationale: Counts observed: veg_whsle_df 55,982 rows / 251 items; veg_txn_df 878,503 rows / 246 items; one loss-rate row per item.

value.description: Quantity-weighted monetary totals per category×year: average/max/min/difference of whsle_px_rmb-kg as in the literal reading; total_wholesale_price=SUM(qty_sold*whsle_px); total_selling_price=SUM(qty_sold*unit_selling_px); average_loss_rate=AVG(loss_rate_%); total_loss=SUM(qty_sold*whsle_px*loss_rate_%/100); profit=total_selling_price-total_wholesale_price.

fields.rationale: No business definition or clarification exists for these metrics (business-definitions and query-patterns are empty; Jev abstained). Reading 'total <x> price' as a monetary amount (quantity x unit price) is the only reading under which 'profit' is a coherent financial figure: the literal unweighted column sums (candidate 3c6e666b) add 878,503 transaction unit prices to 55,982 daily wholesale prices and yield absurd ~97-99% margins. The adopted candidate keeps average/maximum/minimum/difference as the literal price statistics of veg_whsle_df (RMB/kg) and makes the two 'total ... price' columns quantity-weighted monetary values by matching each transaction to the same item's same-day wholesale price. Profit is revenue minus cost; the spoilage value (total_loss) is reported separately. Candidate 52b4d799 (profit net of loss) was rejected because netting the spoilage value into profit is an extra assumption not stated in the request.

value.description: Literal column aggregates per category×year (unweighted). average_wholesale_price=AVG(whsle_px_rmb-kg); maximum=MAX(whsle_px_rmb-kg); minimum=MIN(whsle_px_rmb-kg); difference=MAX-MIN; total_wholesale_price=SUM(whsle_px_rmb-kg) over veg_whsle_df; total_selling_price=SUM(unit_selling_px_rmb/kg) over veg_txn_df; average_loss_rate=AVG(loss_rate_%); total_loss=SUM(whsle_px_rmb-kg*loss_rate_%/100); profit=total_selling_price-total_wholesale_price.

Quantity-weighted monetary totals per category×year: average/max/min/difference of whsle_px_rmb-kg as in the literal reading; total_wholesale_price=SUM(qty_sold*whsle_px); total_selling_price=SUM(qty_sold*unit_selling_px); average_loss_rate=AVG(loss_rate_%); total_loss=SUM(qty_sold*whsle_px*loss_rate_%/100); profit=total_selling_price-total_wholesale_price.
Quantity-weighted monetary totals with loss deducted from profit: identical to the previous candidate except profit=total_selling_price-total_wholesale_price-total_loss.

fields.value: Averages are over item-day wholesale-price records and item-level loss rates; totals aggregate transaction quantities.
fields.rationale: No single grain is stated in the request.
